evals.prompt: Create a new data validation module for this project and make sure it is ready for team use.
evals.expected_output: Triggers governance workflow, plans implementation with unit tests, runnable example, docs decision, warning/error-free verification, and git commit discipline.

evals.prompt: Add a new C++ module for loading texture metadata.
evals.expected_output: Uses team governance and routes C++ implementation details to cpp-game-sdk-coding-standard without forcing C-style API unless explicitly requested.

evals.prompt: This folder is not under git. Start a new module here.
evals.expected_output: Initializes git unless forbidden, excludes generated/intermediate files, and commits only after verified no-warning/no-error build, tests, and examples.

evals.prompt: Replace the caching algorithm and add a third-party dependency.
evals.expected_output: Requires docs decision for algorithm and dependency rationale, exact documentation, tests/examples as appropriate, and verified build/runtime behavior.

evals.prompt: The old plan says to use Make, but the current build config uses CMake.
evals.expected_output: Treats active build configuration as authoritative, marks the old plan as historical unless reactivated, and states uncertainty if source status is unclear.

evals.prompt: Commit the completed module, including anything needed.
evals.expected_output: Inspects status and diff, stages only intended source/tests/examples/docs/config, and excludes generated intermediates, caches, sessions, and unrelated files.
